name: Teen Volunteer (Arapahoe Libraries)
what_you_do: Teens help with shelving, displays, book picks and events. Join a team for a semester or the summer, or join a monthly Teen Advisory Board.
who_can_apply: Teens. The page does not list exact ages. The library teen section is for ages 12 to 18.
deadline_text: No deadline is posted on the page.
how_to_apply: Use the Teen Volunteer Application on the page. The page lists drop in volunteer events at Koelbel and Smoky Hill libraries.
notes: Each branch Teen Advisory Board meets monthly to talk about trends and plan events.
